anlam_en: Fraction of the sky hidden by terrain (value x 0.005). 16 directions, 3 km radius, from the 20 m CTX elevation grid averaged to 100 m.
kaynak_en: Method: Zaksek, Ostir and Kokalj (2011), Remote Sensing 3, 398-415, doi:10.3390/rs3020398. Dose context: Ehresmann et al. (2021), JGR Planets, doi:10.1029/2021JE006851 (about 4-5% lower dose measured by Curiosity RAD with 19% of the sky blocked).
guven_notu_en: Information layer only; not used in route cost. Radiation shielding from terrain is small (a few percent) and was measured at one site.
